Maya (release-manager): Quick heads-up — planning to cut the next release corridor tomorrow 09:30 PT. Primary pieces: api-gateway v0.42.0, runtime patch for kv-cache, and console UI tidy. Assignments below, ping to confirm you're on deck.
Josh (eng-runtime): I can take runtime patch. ETA I'm free during the 09:30 slot. Will run the new quantization smoke first.
Priya (eng-platform): I'll own the gateway deploy and post-deploy routing checks. Can you paste the smoke commands we want run so I can add to the runbook? @Maya
Maya (release-manager): Sure — smoking checklist (minimal):
```
# runtime smoke (kv cache sanity)
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt": "smoke test"}' | jq -r '.choices[0].text'
# gateway routing check
curl -I https://api.redwood/health || true
# console static asset check
curl -sS https://console.redwood/ | grep -q "Redwood Console"
```
Add these to the runbook, thanks.
Dan (eng-sre): I'll be standby for rollback. What's the fallback artifact? full rollback or partial? If runtime patch fails we should canary-back to runtime-v1.14.0 and route traffic to dedicated reserved nodes.
Sasha (eng-ml): Heads-up: model bundle for runtime patch is validated. I will watch token-level latency during canary run. If p50 rises >50ms or error rate >0.5% we abort.
Josh (eng-runtime): For rollback we're prepared with image tags: runtime:v1.14.0 and runtime:v1.14.1-rollback ready. I'll push tags before deploy and leave a manual hold at canary scale=3.
Maya (release-manager): Ok. Plan: 09:30 start, 09:35 canary (scale 3), 09:45 expand to 25%, 10:00 full. @Priya please add schedule to the corridor doc and call if we need to shift.
Priya (eng-platform): Added schedule and the runbook snippet. Also flagged a small infra window at 09:50-09:55 for autoscaler burst — noted in doc.
deploy-bot: Scheduled pipeline: pipeline-id=rlz-202903; slot=09:30-10:00; canary=3; notify=@release-team
Dan (eng-sre): Will watch alerts. I set temporary heartbeat monitor for the corridor: threshold p95 latency 2.5s, error rate 1%. Alerts will go to #oncall and page if tripped.
Sasha (eng-ml): Quick ask — can someone run the sample prompt set after canary? I have a small eval harness: `python eval_prompts.py --tier canary` to run after 09:35.
Josh (eng-runtime): Yep I will trigger that and paste results into the thread. Also I'll leave the canary paused 5m after initial traffic to let eval run.
Maya (release-manager): Perfect. If no objections I'll finalize and call for deploy at 09:20 for quick sync. Drop a :thumbsup: here if you're confirmed.
Priya (eng-platform): :thumbsup:
Josh (eng-runtime): :thumbsup:
Dan (eng-sre): :thumbsup:
Sasha (eng-ml): :thumbsup:
Maya (release-manager): Thanks all — will post the corridor finalized link in 5. If anything changes ping here. Good luck!
